regions.title: PHB p. 27 · Thief scroll-reading ability at 10th level
regions.alt: Source excerpt for Assassin, PHB printed page 27
regions.summary: Complete right-column entries 2–3 on PHB p. 27. Entry 3 states that 10th-level thieves decipher magical writings and use scrolls except clerical (but not druidic) scrolls, and gives a 25% misunderstanding chance. The focus covers the entry through “misunderstood”; the remaining sentence on reversed scroll spells is visible context.

checkedFields.sourceLocation: PHB p. 27 right-column scroll-reading entry, complete in the crop. This establishes the thief’s level-10 reading rule, excluded clerical but not druidic scrolls, and 25% misunderstanding chance; it does not by itself establish the Assassin’s adjusted thief level.

checkedFields.sourceLocation: PHB p. 29 right-column Tertiary functions paragraph. Together with the p. 19 level-12 scroll note, this supports the inference that a 12th-level Assassin uses the thief ability at an effective 10th thief level.
